## 3500 - 3504

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="3500">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />3500 GQ/LQ – Default exceptions for gas and liquid source analyses</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="3500">

Header entry for readability. Not an actual exception generated by FLOWCAL.

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="3501">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />3501 GQ/LQ - Sample pressure must be provided if sample density is given</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="3501">

This exception is generated if a sample density is included on a liquid source or standalone analysis record and the sample pressure, the pressure on the liquid when the sample density was determined, is not provided.

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="3502">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />3502 GQ/LQ - Sample temperature must be provided if sample density is given</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="3502">

This exception is generated if a sample density is included on a liquid source or standalone analysis record and the sample temperature, the temperature of the liquid when the sample density was determined, is not provided.

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="3503">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />3503 GQ/LQ - Sample pressure requires an indicator of gauge or absolute units</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="3503">

This exception is generated if the sample pressure associated with a sample density on a liquid source or standalone analysis record does not include a gauge/absolute indicator.

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="3504">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />3504 GQ/LQ - Atmospheric pressure must be provided if sample pressure is provided in absolute units</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="3504">

This exception is generated if atmospheric pressure has not been provided for a sample pressure that is indicated to be an absolute measurement. This applies to liquid source and standalone analysis records that include a sample density. In order calculate other density values at sample conditions, the pressure must be in gauge conditions.

</div>

</div>
